rules.rationale: Source ESOL: long SMILES strongly reduced solubility (-11.46); anti-correlated endpoint implies higher octanol partitioning.
Source prior: short SMILES raised solubility (+6.89); small polar molecules partition poorly into octanol.
Ring role carried the highest transfer weight (0.758); fused rings add rigid hydrophobic surface area.
Donor-count role maps to heteroatom bin; polar hydratable groups depress partition coefficients, but mapping confidence is low.

skills.hypothesis: Retains the sign-reversed ESOL transfer (size and rings up, small polar molecules down) with a mildly softened heteroatom penalty. Fails if polarity balance, not molecular size, governs lipophilicity in this pool.

rules.rationale: Highest-transfer source role; polycyclic hydrophobic cores dominate octanol affinity in drug-like pools.
Rotatable-bond role transferred strongly (0.758); branched alkyl substituents add nonpolar surface without polar groups.
Molecular size raises hydrophobic surface; long scaffolds generally partition further into the organic phase.
Counter-hypothesis: donor-to-heteroatom mapping is weakest evidence (0.159); heteroatom counts include lipophilic S and halogens.

skills.hypothesis: Counter-hypothesis that near-zeroes the low-confidence heteroatom penalty and relies on ring, branch, and size structure descriptors. Fails if polar heteroatom content is in fact the dominant discriminator of lipophilicity.

state.lesson: Calibration seeds favored the sign-flipped ESOL transfer (88.7 vs 86.4 mean AUC) with lower seed variance; the narrow halogen_high rule covered only 98 candidates and destabilized search.
state.revision_summary: Retained the winning source-evidence skill with slightly firmer size/ring weights, a softened heteroatom penalty, and raised confidence. Replaced the volatile halogen-aromatic skill with a broader-coverage counter-hypothesis that downweights the weakest source mapping (donor to heteroatom, confidence 0.159) and instead uses the high-transfer ring and branch roles. Deployed the retained transfer skill; seed counts are small, so no causal claim is made.
